entities.summary: Burundi is a sovereign nation in East Africa, Africa. Its capital is Gitega (political), Bujumbura (economic). Official languages include Kirundi, French, English. Government: Unitary presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 13.2 million. Area: 27,834 km². Comprehensive index for Burundi covering the Kingdom of Burundi, mwami monarchy, German and Belgian colonialism, Hutu-Tutsi dynamics, 1972 genocide, civil war 1993-2005, and Nkurunziza third-term crisis.
